# D0B-MidLongGroupedObjective

唯一新训练目标为 **scale-matched grouped-objective diagnostic**：固定 (4/3)×(L5+L10+L20)，总损失加原 switch loss；validation / scheduler / early stopping / checkpoint selection 使用相同 grouped prediction objective。head 保留四 horizons；D0B architecture、固定 alpha=.5、routing、optimizer 与数据协议保持原样。

D0B 和 5d-only 均重新加载已有 checkpoint，仅作对照。性能以收益率空间报告；RMSE 沿用 mean(asset-wise RMSE)，Hit 以百分比显示。TRAIN 指 best checkpoint 的完整 TRAIN loader eval，包含尾 batch。

## 十七个问题与最终判定

1. 与 D0B 共享初始化一致：True。

2. 参数量差：0。

3. 初始 group_scaled/sum_multi：0.964828271；固定4/3。

4. VAL 5d 相对 D0B：{"delta_MAE": 0.0020404309034347534, "relative_change": 0.08794725066092024}。

5. TEST 5d 相对 D0B：{"delta_MAE": 0.003432782366871834, "relative_change": 0.15607257536800836}。

6. 相对5d-only：{"VAL": {"delta_MAE": 0.00022353790700435638, "relative_change": 0.008935256302203173}, "TEST": {"delta_MAE": 0.0002051275223493576, "relative_change": 0.008132739855343617}}。

7. 1d trade-off：{"VAL": {"delta_MAE": 0.0031588468700647354, "relative_change": 0.29156225595056195}, "TEST": {"delta_MAE": 0.0030593974515795708, "relative_change": 0.28362951509067375}}。

Posterior 是否介于两 reference 之间：{"VAL": {"entropy": {"values": {"D0B": 1.0893663933736084, "5dOnly": 1.0839789414900123, "Grouped": 1.0812674886299274}, "Grouped_between_references": false}, "mean_max": {"values": {"D0B": 0.37937439734588807, "5dOnly": 0.3890788661455041, "Grouped": 0.4008382062191394}, "Grouped_between_references": false}, "margin": {"values": {"D0B": 0.042199823944203886, "5dOnly": 0.05015830055657607, "Grouped": 0.07492915162844445}, "Grouped_between_references": false}, "temporal_L1": {"values": {"D0B": 0.0308429687536334, "5dOnly": 0.04357672431224552, "Grouped": 0.04868288660672174}, "Grouped_between_references": false}}, "TEST": {"entropy": {"values": {"D0B": 1.0913572520028263, "5dOnly": 1.0689323381614395, "Grouped": 1.0708658146066332}, "Grouped_between_references": true}, "mean_max": {"values": {"D0B": 0.3747939989690887, "5dOnly": 0.4174398003180674, "Grouped": 0.42109806830111934}, "Grouped_between_references": false}, "margin": {"values": {"D0B": 0.04192780830159949, "5dOnly": 0.07749377310442215, "Grouped": 0.0980593962934159}, "Grouped_between_references": false}, "temporal_L1": {"values": {"D0B": 0.030923066674974936, "5dOnly": 0.04490671505248843, "Grouped": 0.05036046714716008}, "Grouped_between_references": false}}}。

Gradient geometry is representation-dependent and cannot directly justify static horizon grouping；不要仅据 cosine 推导结构。

16. 最终判定：{"case": "Case C", "candidate_objective_justified": false, "auxiliary_10_20_healthy": false, "relative_effect_convention": 0.001, "numerical_tie_relative_tolerance": 1e-06, "health_definition": "10d/20d VAL and TEST MAE and RMSE do not worsen by >0.1% vs D0B", "note": "Single seed and approximate scale matching; descriptive evidence, not a statistical significance test.", "reason": "Removing 1d worsens 5d VAL and TEST; auxiliary 1d supervision is beneficial here."}。

17. Grouped objective 是否有资格成为正式优化方向：False。只有最强Case A可支持候选；C/D/E保留D0B，B不足以宣称主要瓶颈。

0.1% 为预先写明的效应大小和10/20健康度报告约定，不参与调参或选模；1e-6 relative MAE 仅用于数值持平检查。若VAL/TEST均改善但并不明显优于5d-only或10/20退化，题设A–E未完全覆盖：报告未分类、需复核，绝不强行给Case A。

Case C

STOP。不启动下一组合、loss-weight search 或新模型。
